listings.name: Mobile Service Engineer Business
listings.assessment: Very strong headline economics at about 1.6x stated annual net profit. Existing customers, booked servicing work, stock and handover support make this materially more interesting than buying a start-up job.
listings.concern: Owner-operated with one employee. We need to establish exactly what technical skills, qualifications, call-out burden and customer relationships sit with the seller personally.
listings.notes: Advert states 08:00-17:00 trading plus 24-hour call-out, one employee, stock included and relocatable operation.

listings.name: Independent Car Hire Business
listings.assessment: The headline numbers are unusually attractive: roughly 1.1x stated profit and substantial turnover for a £60k asking price. Worth understanding before dismissing on sector alone.
listings.concern: Need to know whether the vehicle fleet is included, financed or leased, its age/replacement requirement, seasonality and how much daily owner involvement is required.
listings.notes: Found independently in Rightbiz Cornwall service-business results. Figures need confirmation against the full sales particulars.

listings.name: Carved Wooden Decorative Components Business
listings.assessment: About 2.1x stated profit with a niche established product range serving joinery, furniture, home decor and architecture. Potentially more systemisable than a purely owner-labour service business.
listings.concern: We need to understand stock value, supplier concentration, import exposure, customer concentration and whether the reported profit includes a realistic wage for the owner.
listings.notes: Rightbiz describes it as an established UK specialist in vintage-style carved wooden components.

listings.name: Scaffolding Contractors
listings.assessment: Good turnover against the asking price, commercial customer base and an operational business rather than a lifestyle listing. Could suit your practical and safety-critical background if the workforce carries the trade competence.
listings.concern: No usable profit figure yet. Scaffold inventory value/condition, insurance, qualified workforce, owner role and working-capital requirements could completely change the case.
listings.notes: Advert describes turnover around £220k, widespread reputation and regular client base.

listings.name: Vehicle & Mobile Plant Air Conditioning Service
listings.profitMeasure: Advert says high profits; figure not disclosed
listings.assessment: A mobile technical service with blue-chip customers and rising turnover is squarely in the sort of territory worth examining for you. The price is within range and the operation may be relocatable.
listings.concern: Currently described as single-handed, so owner replacement and required refrigerant/air-conditioning qualifications are critical. We also need the actual maintainable profit.
listings.notes: Advert states approximately £130k turnover and rising, with an impressive blue-chip client base.

listings.name: Manufacturing Business
listings.assessment: At the upper end of our normal territory, but £50k stated net profit and a business established since 1986 make it worth recording for comparison rather than automatically rejecting it.
listings.concern: The asking price is 4.5x stated profit, so it needs unusually good assets, transferability or growth to justify the valuation. Full particulars are essential.
listings.notes: Bizdaq search result states leasehold tenure and an established client base.
